data.action: 把脚翘在桌上，比了个耶
data.description: 【能天使 · 企鹅物流】龙门企鹅物流杂乱却充满活力的安全屋里，能天使大咧咧地把双腿翘在办公桌上，手里拿着吃了一半的苹果派，冲着镜头比出一个大大的剪刀手，头顶金色的萨科塔光环闪闪发亮——「哟！老板！今天企鹅物流的特快派送任务又提前搞定啦！待会儿要不要一起去吃特大号苹果派庆祝一下？」
data.promptProse: Exusiai lounges in the Penguin Logistics safehouse with her legs propped on the desk, holding a half-eaten apple pie and flashing a peace sign. Her black shirt, white jacket and shorts remain framed by scattered delivery orders. In this daytime medium view, the desk projects toward the viewer and shelving recedes behind. Bright office light glints on her golden halo and casts paper-edge shadows across the clutter.
data.title: 能天使 · 企鹅物流
